steps.title: Idle Settings and retained local server draft
preconditions: Prepared CLI journey candidate. Native NOT RUN by this worker. No measured execution claim. Existing settings-navigation runs an isolated automation session with default Codex endpoint and signed-out Scriv account.
Runner owns fresh private preferences. Each of the original two cycles selects Codex then Account then General, keeping the existing follow-playback toggle/pane persistence/restoration assertions.

No provider, runtime, connect, start, sign-in, sign-out, save-server, pairing, keychain, clipboard or external URL action occurs. Server draft uses a reserved .invalid hostname and is restored without saving.

CodexConnectionReadiness blocker strings, CodexConnectionCheck begin/finish/cancel/reset, connected/sign-in/model selection, async cancellation, pairing management, process persistence and cloud URL mutation remain unclaimed. Idle presentation cannot witness those paths. Snapshot absence is visibility evidence, not a network audit.

expectations.description: Actual idle Codex pane has exact Not connected label, Connect controls enabled, hidden account/model/stop/cancel/error controls, enabled untouched fields and literal default endpoint and automatic executable. No runtime request is made.

Signed-out Account pane shows exact local-account text and sign-in control. Expanding server settings exposes enabled field/save control and explanation. Synthetic unsaved draft survives close/reopen, editing ends, original text is restored and disclosure closes.
